originalTitle: U.S. stock futures little changed as investors await Nvidia earnings
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were steady on Sunday evening as investors looked ahead to Nvidia's quarterly results later this week for fresh clues on the strength of artificial intelligence demand, after Wall Street posted weekly gains despite a sharp decline in the chipmaker's shares.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were steady on Sunday evening as investors looked ahead to Nvidia's quarterly results later this week for fresh clues on the strength of artificial intelligence demand, after Wall Street posted weekly gains despite a sharp decline in the chipmaker's shares.

S&P 500 Futures inched 0.1% higher to 7,587.25 points, while Nasdaq 100 Futures gained 0.1% to 28,040.75 points by 20:10 ET (01:10 GMT). Dow Jones Futures also traded 0.1% higher at 40,140.0 points.

Despite Friday's declines, major U.S. stock indexes ended the week higher for the first time since early October. The S&P 500 gained 2.5% for the week, while the NASDAQ Composite rose 2.3% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 2.1%.

The move followed a volatile end to the previous week, when technology stocks came under pressure as Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) shares plunged nearly 13% for the week.

Nvidia's Co-founder and Chief Executive Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday following revelations about multiple extramarital relationships, including one with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of acting on behalf of Beijing.

This raised questions about leadership continuity at the world's most valuable semiconductor company and its central role in the AI industry.

Investors are now looking for Nvidia's fiscal third-quarter results, due on Tuesday, November 17, after the market close. Its performance and outlook will be closely watched for evidence that demand for AI processors remains strong enough to justify the massive investments being made by technology companies.

The results will also be Nvidia's first since Huang stepped down, with Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress serving as interim chief executive. Investors are expected to seek clarity on the company's leadership transition alongside its financial outlook.

Another key event this week is the expected initial public offering of artificial intelligence startup Anthropic, which is expected to price its shares on Wednesday and begin trading on Nasdaq on Thursday.

The listing could provide another gauge of investor appetite for AI-related companies amid growing debate over valuations and the returns from heavy infrastructure spending.

Beyond technology, investors will assess earnings from major retailers, including Home Depot Inc (NYSE:HD), Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) and Walmart Inc (NASDAQ:WMT), for indications of consumer spending strength ahead of the holiday shopping season.

chineseTitle: 由于投资者等待英伟达财报，美国股指期货几乎没有变化
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周日晚间，美国股指期货保持稳定，投资者期待英伟达本周晚些时候公布的季度业绩，以寻找有关人工智能需求强劲程度的新线索，尽管该芯片制造商股价大幅下跌，但华尔街股市每周上涨。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周日晚间，美国股指期货保持稳定，投资者期待英伟达本周晚些时候公布的季度业绩，以寻找有关人工智能需求强劲程度的新线索，尽管该芯片制造商股价大幅下跌，但华尔街股市每周上涨。

截至美国东部时间 20:10（格林威治标准时间 01:10），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.1%，至 7,587.25 点，纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.1%，至 28,040.75 点。道琼斯期货也上涨 0.1%，至 40,140.0 点。

尽管周五下跌，但美国主要股指自 10 月初以来首次本周收高。标准普尔 500 指数本周上涨 2.5%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨 2.3%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 2.1%。

上周市场波动较大，英伟达 (NASDAQ:NVDA) 股价本周暴跌近 13%，科技股承压。

股票已经上涨后，停止追逐股票。通过人工智能选股、收益见解和市场动态新闻寻找下一个投资机会。雅虎！财经读者在黑色星期五 55% 折扣的基础上还可享受额外 15% 的折扣。今天加入！ »

英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋周四辞职，此前他的多起婚外情被曝光，其中包括与中国女商人黄爱丽的一段婚外情，美国情报官员怀疑她代表北京行事。

这引发了人们对全球最有价值的半导体公司的领导连续性及其在人工智能行业中的核心作用的质疑。

投资者现在正在关注 Nvidia 第三季度财报，该财报将于 11 月 17 日星期二收盘后公布。其性能和前景将受到密切关注，以寻找证据表明对人工智能处理器的需求仍然强劲，足以证明科技公司进行大规模投资是合理的。

这也将是英伟达自黄仁勋卸任、首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)担任临时首席执行官以来的首次业绩。预计投资者将寻求澄清该公司的领导层过渡及其财务前景。

本周的另一个关键事件是人工智能初创公司 Anthropic 预计首次公开募股，预计该公司将于周三对其股票进行定价，并于周四开始在纳斯达克交易。

在关于估值和大量基础设施支出回报的争论日益激烈之际，此次上市可能会提供投资者对人工智能相关公司兴趣的另一个衡量标准。

除了科技之外，投资者还将评估家得宝公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：HD）、塔吉特公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TGT）和沃尔玛公司（纳斯达克股票代码：WMT）等主要零售商的收益，以了解假日购物季之前消费者支出强劲的迹象。
